description: This Java class implements a thread-safe cache for tenant entity profiles, managing associations between profile IDs and entity IDs with methods for adding, removing, updating, and retrieving entities.

classes.name: TenantEntityProfileCache
classes.description: A thread-safe cache managing associations between tenant profile IDs and entity IDs, supporting add, remove, update, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: removeProfileId
methods.description: Removes all entity associations for a given profile ID.

methods.name: removeEntityId
methods.description: Removes an entity ID from all profile associations.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific entity ID from a specific profile ID.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Associates an entity ID with a profile ID, with validation on entity type.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the association from an old profile ID to a new profile ID for a given entity.

methods.name: getEntityIdsByProfileId
methods.description: Retrieves all entity IDs associated with a given profile ID.
